name: Jasmine oil
description: Jasmine oil (CAS 8022-96-6 ), also known as Jasmin Absolute, is a natural aromatic extract derived from jasmine flowers and valued across fragrance and flavor markets for its rich, floral scent profile. With FEMA 2601 designation, it functions as a premium fragrance ingredient and flavoring agent in both consumer and industrial formulations. In fine fragrance and personal care, it anchors floral compositions. It is used in perfumes, body lotions, and hair care products where a recognizable jasmine note is required. Food and beverage manufacturers incorporate it as a natural flavoring in teas, confectionery, and baked goods. These applications are maintained at regulated usage levels to ensure safety and consistency. Home care formulators use it to impart a lasting floral character to fabric softeners, candles, and air care products. Pharmaceutical and cosmetic manufacturers also source it for its moisturizing contribution in skin-conditioning formulations. Jasmine oil is supplied as a liquid or semi-solid absolute depending on extraction method. Standard grades include food-grade (FEMA-compliant) and cosmetic-grade material, with natural and organic-certified variants available for clean-label applications. Quality is maintained through rigorous testing protocols. Packaging typically ranges from small amber glass units for specialty buyers to bulk quantities for industrial formulators.
